body.message: Azure VM discovery, backup protection checks, and on-demand backup processing are in progress.

body.query: @concat('Resources | where type =~ ''microsoft.compute/virtualmachines'' | extend OSHostName=tostring(properties.osProfile.computerName) | extend ShortOSHostName=tostring(split(OSHostName,''.'')[0]) | where toupper(name) == ''',outputs('Normalize_Current_Hostname'),''' or toupper(OSHostName) == ''',outputs('Normalize_Current_Hostname'),''' or toupper(ShortOSHostName) == ''',outputs('Normalize_Current_Hostname'),''' | join kind=leftouter (ResourceContainers | where type =~ ''microsoft.resources/subscriptions'' | project subscriptionId, SubscriptionName=name) on subscriptionId | project Hostname=OSHostName, VMName=name, SubscriptionId=subscriptionId, SubscriptionName, ResourceGroup=resourceGroup, Location=location, ResourceId=id')
